simple-datatables
=================

Vendored simple-datatables version 10.3.0 for the documentation site's
sortable, searchable tables.

Project: https://github.com/fiduswriter/simple-datatables
Documentation: https://fiduswriter.github.io/simple-datatables/
Package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/simple-datatables/v/10.3.0
License: LGPL-3.0; see LICENSE in this directory.

The JavaScript and CSS files are unmodified distribution assets from the pinned
npm package. When upgrading, replace both distribution files and the license,
then exercise docs/assets/javascripts/extra.js against the new major version
before changing mkdocs.yml.
